selection_status: Post-acquisition source-QC contract; duplicate IDs and row permutation were known before this implementation. This is not prospective biological validation.

sources.quantity: SeqMonk log2 RPM as declared by GSE165177; not raw counts or predicted ages.

join_policy: Join by the full unique locus key. Require identical key sets and matching annotations for each key. Preserve all feature rows and every numeric text value; never collapse repeated gene IDs or join by row number.
sample_policy: Exact unique title match within the GSE165177 metadata is admitted as a within-RNA title match only. The five explicit space/underscore aliases below are provisional and excluded from the frozen comparison. Unrecognized labels, alias collisions, reused sample IDs and duplicated columns fail.
frozen_comparison_policy: All 26 arms must have exact title matches. Report only RNA-expression availability for the 13 frozen contrasts. Culture-level function matching, original clock ages, permissions and the frozen Gill analysis gates remain separate.
output_scope: RNA source QC, original-value preservation and locus-aligned recovery only. No clock training, expression normalization, molecular-age calculation, efficacy, restoration, safety, persistence or Phase 483 closure.
